Incorporated ${year}. Slab poured the same season, per the contractor's certificate hanging beside it. Every other date in this building has been amended at least once. The board has never permitted this one to be touched, and nobody in the room will say why that matters.
SERVER:
RACK 14 — THERMAL EXCEPTION

Cold aisle is holding. Hot aisle is holding. The room between them is four degrees warmer than either, which is not a thing a room is allowed to do. Filed with facilities. Facilities filed it back.

OUTBOUND TRAFFIC SUMMARY — UNSIGNED

Sustained upstream at hour ${hrs} with no session open and no user logged. Payload is not encrypted, it is just not anything. The carrier tone sits at the same frequency as the fan wash and I only found it because I turned the fans OFF and it was still there.

TAPED TO THE CONSOLE

Do not reboot rack 9. I know what the ticket says. Rack 9 has not been powered since the site opened and it is still warm. — ${c.custodian}

No corresponding OUT.

POSTED AT THE SUIT RACK

Count your gear on the way back. If you return with a suit you did not sign out, hang it and say nothing. If you return with two, come find me. — ${c.custodian}

Stop coming to the gate for the records number. Nobody here has it because nobody anywhere has it. It is assembled, not issued: pour year, then the pen that stands open, two digits each. The last three people who wanted it went to the annex to be told and one of them is still there being told.

"THIS FACILITY COMMISSIONED ${year}."

DEFAULT:

Subject exhibited extreme paranoia after ${hrs} hours. Claimed the hum of the fluorescent lights was a linguistic sequence. We cut the power, but the humming didn't stop.

MEMO

${c.lead} says the exits are a motivational tool. ${c.archivist} says the exits are load-bearing. ${c.lost} said the exits are a rumor the building spreads about itself. ${c.lost} was smiling when they said it. Nobody has seen that smile since.

CAFETERIA NOTICE

The almond water is not a beverage. The almond water is a countermeasure. Ration accordingly. — FACILITIES

There was no breach. Review every log: it never came IN. The entity predates the facility. The facility predates the level. We did not build a laboratory around a specimen. It grew a specimen around a laboratory.

${c.lead}'s final margin note: "We are the note it left for itself."

PROJECT ${P} — FINDING OF FACT

${c.lost} is alive. That is the finding. Every door that will not open has been locked FROM THE INSIDE, by hand, in ${c.lost}'s handwriting, in chalk, on the side we cannot see. ${c.lost} is not trapped in here with it.

It is trapped in here with ${c.lost}.

RECORDS ROOM — SEALED FILE
PROJECT ${P} — FINDING OF FACT

The hum is a carrier wave. ${c.archivist} proved it in the stacks: the documents rearrange along it. The building is not haunted. The building is TRANSMITTING — inventory, floor plans, personnel files — somewhere. We are not test subjects.

We are the payload.

foreshadow.SERVER:
HARDWARE PROVENANCE — RACK 9

No purchase order. No install ticket. No serial in any inventory we hold. Rack 9 appears on the earliest floor plan we have, which is dated before the slab was poured, and the slab was poured around it.
foreshadow.CLINIC:
TISSUE SAMPLE — LOGGED, NEVER TAKEN

Sample 001 predates the clinic's commissioning by nine years. Chain of custody begins with a signature nobody can match to a person. The sample is not from a patient. Read the site survey. The sample is from the site.
foreshadow.CHASM:
ANCHOR SURVEY — LOAD BEARING

The catwalk anchors are set into a face that is older than the excavation that supposedly exposed it. We did not cut this void. We found it, and we hung walkways in it, and we wrote "excavation" on the invoice.

foreshadow.SERVER:
BADGE AUDIT — RACK ROOM DOOR

${c.lost}'s credential is still cycling. Forty-one reads since the disappearance, all from the inside face of doors we have logged as sealed. The credential is not cloned. It is being carried.
foreshadow.CLINIC:
SUPPLY VARIANCE — WARD STORES

Gauze, water and ration bars run short on a fortnightly cycle nobody has authorised. Nothing else moves. Whoever is taking it is taking exactly what one person needs and is being careful not to be greedy about it.
foreshadow.CHASM:
CATWALK ACCESS PLATE — RESEALED

Plate 6 was cut open from the underside and bolted shut again from the underside, which requires somebody to be down there when it closed and to still be down there now. Bolts are hand-tight. Whoever did it expects to come back through.

IT BULLETIN, ADDENDUM
FROM: FACILITIES (${c.custodian})

Outbound network traffic spiked again last night. Nobody was logged in. The packets are personnel files.
Ours.
foreshadow.SERVER:
UPSTREAM CAPTURE — HOUR ${hrs}

Decoded a frame. It is an inventory. It lists the racks, the wing, the staff roster and the contents of the records room, in that order, formatted for something that is not us and reads bottom-up.
foreshadow.CLINIC:
AUDIOLOGY, FINAL ENTRY

The tone is amplitude modulated. I plotted six hours of it against the personnel index and the peaks land on the roll call. It is not a symptom. It is a manifest, and we are being read out on it.
foreshadow.CHASM:
ARRAY SURVEY — VOID FACE

What the drawings call structural bracing across the chasm face is a phased element, correctly spaced for the carrier frequency, aimed up the shaft and out. The building is not haunted. The building has an antenna and we hung catwalks off it.
